aliases: cold eyes killer move cold eyes immortal killer move

summary.text: Cold Eyes is Bai Ning Bing's killer move. At Bay Pavilion she freezes a storey building water elephant into a giant ice block.

claims.text: She stands in a white robe with her arms crossed, dragon eyes flashing with cold light. She seems not to have made a move, but she has already activated the killer move. The frozen elephant soon turns back into a blue light that passes through the ice layer and returns to Bay Pavilion unobstructed. Fang Yuan, who does not thoroughly understand her killer moves, judges that this should be cold eyes, used to stop that blue light from returning, and that it is of no use. She inherited Bai Xiang’s true inheritance, and they are only allies.

Chai Po Jun’s neutralize wood body directly destroys this immortal killer move and can disregard it. The move is quite troublesome to deal with. Fang Yuan had been struck by it when he was chasing Ying Wu Xie and the rest. Bai Xiang’s true inheritance holds more than this one move, and Chai Po Jun takes quite a few injuries while fighting her.

Against Feng Jiu Ge a thick layer of frost is already on his arms and back before he notices. She only needs him in her field of vision. Even though he moves quickly, the killer move is even faster, nearly instantaneous. He laughs, stretches out his palm, and bell sounds melt the frost. When he teleports and reappears, he is met with it again. Like Fairy Miao Yin’s curved moon, it is a sight based attack, extremely quick to activate.
